raw_html: [[Named item sets#Planar Focus: Erudition|Planar Focus: Erudition]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Named item sets#Planar Focus: Erudition|Planar Focus: Erudition]]:''' When this item is equipped at the same time as a [[Planar Conflux]], you will gain the benefit of Spell Penetration IX, a +250 Enhancement bonus to your maximum Spell Point total, and a +15 Psionic bonus to your Universal Spell Power.
